title: PWC Core v0.2.1 (strict)
description: Machine-readable companion of PWC-CORE-001 v0.2.1. If this schema and the specification text disagree, the text prevails (Core §3.2). x-pwc-methods maps every Core method to its params, direct result and, for Operation-returning methods, the completed Operation result. Strict variant: unknown members are rejected; use it to test Provider output.
